base.name: Asian Paints Ltd
base.about: Asian Paints is the largest home decor company in India. The 80+yr old company has major brands like Asian Paints, Apco, etc under its umbrella. The co. is into wall paints, wall coverings, waterproofing, texture painting, wall stickers, mechanized tools, adhesives, modular kitchens, sanitaryware, lightings, soft furnishings, and uPVC windows.

guidance.statement: We are looking at mid-single-digit value growth for the full year.
guidance.quote: We are looking at mid-single-digit value growth for the full year.
guidance.speaker: Amit Syngle, MD and CEO

guidance.statement: Volumes would be higher, with the gap between volume and value remaining around 4-5%.
guidance.quote: and therefore, we would anticipate that the gap between the volume and the value would remain in that zone of about 4-5%.
guidance.speaker: Amit Syngle, MD and CEO

guidance.statement: Maintain the PBDIT margin band of 18 to 20%.
guidance.quote: Given all this, it is okay to maintain the whole guidance of 18 to 20% PBDIT margin band.
guidance.speaker: Amit Syngle, MD and CEO

guidance.statement: Committed a capex of about Rs. 3,250 crores for the VAM VAE project.
guidance.quote: the VAM VAE project in which we have committed to the project a CAPEX of about Rs. 3,250 crores.
guidance.speaker: Amit Syngle, MD and CEO

extracts.tone: Confident, driven by strong internal initiatives, brand investments, and volume recovery despite muted external demand conditions and extended monsoons.

guidance.statement: Endeavour to maintain PBDIT margins within the 18% to 20% band.
guidance.quote: I would say that we would keep the guidance between that 18 and 20% band as we go ahead and that is something which we will endeavour to maintain.
guidance.speaker: Amit Syngle, MD and CEO

guidance.statement: Endeavour to grow higher than the market and achieve material market share gains.
guidance.quote: All our strategies are geared towards the fact that today would like to possibly grow to some extent higher than the market.

extracts.tone: Confident yet cautious; management highlighted robust volume growth and all-time high gross margins, but expressed caution regarding ongoing geopolitical volatility, raw material inflation, and intense market competition.

analystConcerns.theme: Pricing actions, inflation pass-through, and extent of shortfall vs raw material price hikes
Sustained high competitive intensity and discounting levels from new and existing players
Volume growth trajectory, demand sustainability, and sustainability of the 18-20% margin guidance

guidance.statement: Management expects full-year volume growth to be in the band of 8% to 10%.
guidance.quote: overall, we have given our direction that we should stay in the volume region of about 8-10%. At the current stage, we are looking at the band of 8-10% for the full FY27.
